# pcd_dns_recordset (Resource)

Manages a recordset within a DNS zone in PCD's Designate service. Operations are asynchronous; applies wait for the recordset to reach an `ACTIVE` status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_dns_zone" "example" {
  name  = "example.com."
  email = "admin@example.com"
}

resource "pcd_dns_recordset" "example" {
  zone_id = pcd_dns_zone.example.id
  name    = "www.example.com."
  type    = "A"
  ttl     = 300
  records = ["10.0.0.1", "10.0.0.2"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The recordset name — a fully-qualified domain name ending in a dot. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `records` (Set of String) The record values. Not refreshed from the server after apply; for record types Designate canonicalizes (e.g. TXT values are quoted), write the values as stored to keep imports and reads exact.
- `type` (String) The record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, ...). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `zone_id` (String) The zone the recordset belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the recordset.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `ttl` (Number) The recordset TTL in seconds. Omit to inherit the zone default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The recordset ID.
- `status` (String) The recordset status (e.g. ACTIVE).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_dns_recordset.example <zone_id>/<recordset_id>
```
